archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast / Authority) blended with 'Old Money Tech' styling

brand_identity.vibe: Modern university research lab. Clean, professional, slightly academic, authoritative.
brand_identity.concept: A premium, functional space for elite entrepreneurship students. It must feel like a high-end research facility—efficient, focused, with zero friction.

primary.description: Deep Navy (IIT Bombay identity anchor). Use for primary CTAs, active states, and dominant text.

accent.description: Warm Amber. Use sparingly for highlights, secondary CTAs, or selected states on the floor map.

background.description: Soft off-white. The canvas for the entire application.

surface.description: Pure white cards with very subtle navy-tinted borders.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-serif font-light tracking-tight text-[#1B2A4E]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight text-[#1B2A4E]
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-slate-500

rules: No Inter or generic sans-serif for headings (H1-H3).
Use Source Serif 4 to convey institutional prestige.
Use E1 Generous Spacing Philosophy: opt for p-6 or p-8 inside cards.
Never center-align large blocks of text; keep left-aligned for data and readability.
Grid items must be direct children of the grid container.

surfaces.header: bg-[#FAFAF7]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#1B2A4E]/10 z-50 sticky top-0

buttons.primary: bg-[#1B2A4E] text-white hover:bg-[#1B2A4E]/90 rounded-xl px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#E8A33D] text-[#1B2A4E] hover:bg-[#E8A33D]/90 rounded-xl px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-[#1B2A4E]/20 text-[#1B2A4E] hover:bg-[#1B2A4E]/5 rounded-xl px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-colors

floor_map.container: relative w-full aspect-[4/3] bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#1B2A4E]/10 p-4
floor_map.seat_available: fill-white stroke-[#1B2A4E]/20 hover:stroke-[#E8A33D] hover:fill-[#E8A33D]/10 cursor-pointer transition-colors

shadcn_overrides: Override standard Shadcn 8px radii to 12px (rounded-xl) for a slightly softer, modern look.
Ensure all Shadcn popovers and dialogs use the #FFFFFF background with the tinted shadow.
Use Shadcn tables but increase row padding (py-4) for data readability.

icons.style: Clean, crisp, 1.5px stroke width. Do not use filled icons unless representing an active state.

rules: Use Framer Motion sparingly for modal entrances (fade-in, slide-up).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Deep Navy (#1B2A4E) meets APCA standards.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="book-slot-btn"`).

hero_network_bg.description: Subtle gradient (navy/amber) or a local static asset under public/; keep contrast high for Source Serif headings.

coworking_floor_abstract.description: Optional local illustration next to 'How it works' or 'About the Space' — add under public/ when available.

students_collaborating.description: Photo of students working. Use for the 'Join the Community' CTA area or Auth screen backgrounds.

modern_university.description: Modern architecture shot. Perfect for the split-screen login/signup page background.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React frontend using Javascript (.js/.jsx). Do not generate TypeScript files.
Set up Tailwind with the custom colors: primary (#1B2A4E), accent (#E8A33D), and background (#FAFAF7).
Include Google Fonts: 'Source Serif 4' for the serif family and 'Inter' for the sans-serif family.
Implement the 55-seat floor map using an interactive SVG or a CSS Grid layout, ensuring colors map to the seat_available, seat_booked, and seat_selected definitions.

Use Shadcn components for all forms, modals, tables, and dropdowns, but heavily customize them to remove the default 'Vercel' look (apply rounded-xl, the designated colors, and slightly larger padding).
For the Landing Page, construct custom HTML/Tailwind bento-box layouts. Do not rely heavily on Shadcn 'Card' components for marketing—build expressive, asymmetrical layouts.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, links, form inputs, menus, and table actions.
Ensure the Admin dashboard uses a strict, dense grid layout maximizing screen real-estate for KPIs, Approvals, and Violation tracking.
Never use placeholder text for the brand logo. Instead, render 'DSSE' using the Source Serif 4 font, tracking-tight, text-2xl, and #1B2A4E color.
